REQUEST: Well, my old jacket's zipper split clean open on the walk to class Tuesday (the third time that thing's quit on me), so now I'm ordering before the real cold hits. Our first frost is supposed to land around the second week of November, and I'd like it here before then. Fall/winter clothing is the category, and the style has to be a trench coat, nothing else (I'll check the listing myself, don't worry). Only something you've actually got on hand, not just a listing sitting on a website somewhere. Not a cent over 1250 cts, y'all (every penny counts when you're a student, and loans ain't gonna pay themselves). If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). I get paid from my campus job on the 1st, so that's when I'm placing the order. Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks). Any delivery speed is fine so long as it doesn't turn into a long uphill slog of waiting. The closure can be double breasted or zipper and nothing else, sugar.
